subject: general
question: Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma was an exponent of which Indian classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma**, popularly known as Satyam, was an Indian classical dancer and choreographer, considered by many as one of the leading exponents of the classical dance form of **Kuchipudi**.
 
• He was known for his portrayal of **female** characters such as Usha, Satyabhama, Deva Devi, Mohini, Sasirekha, and Gollabhama .
 
• He was a recipient of several honors including **Kalidas Samman, Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, and Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship**.
 
• The Government of India awarded him the fourth highest civilian honor of the** Padma Shri**, in 1970, for his contributions to Dance.
 
• It is said that once even Prime Minister** Jawaharlal Nehru **sat coyly next to Vedantam in the audience recollecting the role that Vedantam had played as a female and the immediate reaction to consider him as the character itself and the basic etiquette that a female is required to show in public.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi**, also referred to as Orissa in old literature, is a major ancient Indian classical dance that origin in the Hindu temples of Odisha – an eastern coastal state of India.
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a major form of Indian classical dance that originated in Tamil Nadu. The dance form is also briefly mentioned in Kannada text Manasollasa written by Someshwara III.
 
• **Kathak** is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance.It is the classical dance form of Uttar Pradesh. The origin of Kathak is traditionally attributed to the traveling bards in the of ancient northern India known as Kathakars or storytellers.
